reviewers.summary: Most listed source outcomes are wired to the expected diagnostic event. The production startup fixture-loading path misses the required rejection event.

findingList.message: Production fixture-load failures do not emit the rejected-fixture diagnostic because the startup call omits the optional logger.

evidence.codePathTraced: Program.cs calls LoadPinned with only the fixture directory. The optional logger is therefore null, and the catch at line 78 skips FixtureRejected.
evidence.failureScenario: When a production fixture is missing or invalid during startup, LoadPinned rethrows without emitting the required source.fixture.rejected ERROR/17 event. The new test supplies a logger through LoadPinnedAndPublish, so it does not cover this production call path.

reviewers.summary: The read and mode-change outcomes are covered by the contract test, but fixture rejection is only tested through a seam that explicitly supplies a logger. The existing production call path can fail without emitting the required event.

findingList.message: Fixture rejection diagnostics are skipped on the existing production call path because it does not supply a logger. Wire the production fixture loader to a logger and cover that path in the contract test.

evidence.codePathTraced: LoadPinned accepts a nullable logger with a null default, and its catch block emits FixtureRejected only when a logger is supplied. Existing one-argument production calls remain valid and leave the logger null; the new test passes a logger explicitly.
evidence.failureScenario: When production loads a rejected fixture through LoadPinned(directory), the exception is rethrown without emitting source.fixture.rejected, so the fixture-load outcome is absent from production diagnostics.

reviewers.summary: Fixture rejection logging is exercised only through the test helper; the production LoadPinned path defaults to no logger and emits no rejection event.

findingList.message: Fixture rejection telemetry is not wired into the production load path. Pass the production logger to LoadPinned so validation failures emit the required event (OWASP A09:2025).

evidence.codePathTraced: LoadPinned catches fixture-load failures but emits the rejection event only when its optional logger argument is non-null. The production call site is not updated in this diff, so it continues to use the null default.
evidence.failureScenario: A production fixture fails validation during startup. LoadPinned rethrows without emitting source.fixture.rejected, so the required security diagnostic is absent.
